source.text: תְּהִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥דאֲרוֹמִמְךָ֣ אֱלוֹהַ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַאֲבָרֲכָ֥ה שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: A praise of David. I will exalt you, my God, the King, and I will bless your name forever and ever.

en.L: A praise of David. I will exalt {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, my God, the King, and I will bless {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name forever and ever.
en.B: A song of praise. Of David. My God, the King, I will lift {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} high in praise and bless {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name for ever and ever.
en.R: A song of praise. By David. My God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are the King! I will tell how great {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are. I will always praise {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, forever and ever.

fr.L: Louange de David. Je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}exalterai, mon Dieu, le Roi, et je bénirai {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom à tout jamais.
fr.B: Un chant de louange. De David. Mon Dieu, le Roi, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}élèverai bien haut par ma louange et je bénirai {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom pour toujours et à jamais.
fr.R: Un chant de louange. De David. Mon Dieu, c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} le Roi ! Je dirai combien {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es grand. Je louerai toujours {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, pour toujours et à jamais.

sw.L: Sifa ya Daudi. \q Nitakutukuza, Mungu wangu, Mfalme, \q nami nitalibariki jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} milele na milele.
sw.B: Wimbo wa sifa. Wa Daudi. \q Mungu wangu, Mfalme, \q nitakuinua juu kwa sifa na kulibariki jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} milele na milele.
sw.R: Wimbo wa sifa. Wa Daudi. \q Mungu wangu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiwe Mfalme! \q Nitawaambia watu jinsi ulivyo mkuu. Nitalisifu jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} daima, milele na milele.

es.L: Alabanza de David. Te ensalzaré, Dios mío, el Rey, y bendeciré {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre por siempre jamás.
es.B: Canto de alabanza. De David. Dios mío, el Rey, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} exaltaré con alabanzas y bendeciré {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre por los siglos de los siglos.
es.R: Canto de alabanza. De David. Dios mío, ¡{{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres el Rey! Contaré lo grande que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres. Siempre alabaré {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, por siempre jamás.

vi.L: [Một] lời ca ngợi của Đa-vít. \q Tôi sẽ tôn cao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, \q là Vua, và tôi sẽ chúc tụng danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời mãi mãi.
vi.B: Bài ca ngợi. Của Đa-vít. \q Lạy Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, là Vua, \q tôi sẽ ca ngợi tôn cao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và chúc tụng danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời mãi mãi.
vi.R: Bài ca ngợi. Của Đa-vít. \q Lạy Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Vua! \q Tôi sẽ nói lên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vĩ đại biết bao. Tôi sẽ luôn ca ngợi danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, đời đời mãi mãi.

ko.L: 다윗의 찬양. \q 제가 주님을 높이겠습니다, 저의 하나님, 왕이시여. \q 제가 주님의 이름을 영원히 그리고 영원토록 송축하겠습니다.
ko.B: 다윗의 찬양 노래. \q 왕이신 저의 하나님, \q 제가 주님을 높이 찬양하며 주님의 이름을 영원무궁토록 송축하겠습니다.
ko.R: 다윗의 찬양 노래. \q 저의 하나님, 주님은 왕이십니다! \q 제가 주님께서 얼마나 위대하신지 말하겠습니다. 영원히 언제까지나 주님의 이름을 찬양하겠습니다.

pt.L: Louvor de Davi. Eu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} exaltarei, meu Deus, o Rei, e bendirei o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome para todo o sempre.
pt.B: Cântico de louvor. De Davi. Meu Deus, o Rei, eu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} exaltarei com louvores e bendirei o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome para todo o sempre.
pt.R: Cântico de louvor. De Davi. Meu Deus, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és o Rei! Vou contar como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és grande. Vou louvar o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome sempre, para todo o sempre.

am.L: የዳዊት ምስጋና። \q አምላኬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፣ ከፍ ከፍ አደርግሃለሁ፤ \q ስምህንም ለዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም እባርካለሁ።
am.B: የምስጋና መዝሙር። የዳዊት። \q አምላኬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፣ በምስጋና ከፍ ከፍ አደርግሃለሁ፤ \q ስምህንም ለዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም እባርካለሁ።
am.R: የምስጋና መዝሙር። ዳዊት የዘመረው። \q አምላኬ ሆይ፣ አንተ ንጉሥ ነህ! \q ምን ያህል ታላቅ እንደ ሆንክ እናገራለሁ። ስምህን ለዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ሁልጊዜ አመሰግናለሁ።

hi.L: दाऊद की स्तुति। हे मेरे परमेश्वर, हे राजा, मैं तुझे सराहूँगा, और सदा-सर्वदा तेरे नाम को धन्य कहूँगा।
hi.B: स्तुति का गीत। दाऊद का। हे मेरे परमेश्वर, हे राजा, मैं स्तुति में तुझे ऊँचा उठाऊँगा और सदा-सर्वदा तेरे नाम को धन्य कहूँगा।
hi.R: स्तुति का गीत। दाऊद का लिखा हुआ। हे मेरे परमेश्वर, तू ही राजा है! मैं बताऊँगा कि तू कितना महान है। मैं सदा-सर्वदा तेरे नाम की स्तुति करता रहूँगा।

ru.L: Хвала Давида. Я буду превозносить {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}, Боже мой, Царь, и благословлять {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя во веки веков.
ru.B: Хвалебная песнь. Давида. Боже мой, Царь, я буду возвеличивать {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} в хвале и благословлять {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя во веки веков.
ru.R: Хвалебная песня. Написал Давид. Боже мой, {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} — Царь! Я буду рассказывать, как {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} велик. Я всегда буду хвалить {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя, во веки веков.

ja.L: ダビデの賛美。わたしの神、王よ、わたしはあなたをあがめ、とこしえに、いつまでも、あなたの名をほめたたえる。
ja.B: 賛美。ダビデによる。わたしの神、王よ、わたしはあなたを高くあがめ、とこしえに、いつまでも、あなたの名をほめたたえる。
ja.R: 賛美の歌。ダビデによる。わたしの神よ、あなたこそ王だ！わたしは、あなたがどれほど偉大な方かを語ろう。これからもずっと、いつまでも、あなたの名をほめたたえよう。

uk.L: Хвала Давида. Я звеличуватиму {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, мій Боже, Царю, і благословлятиму {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} імʼя навіки-віків.
uk.B: Пісня хвали. Давидова. Мій Боже, Царю, я підноситиму {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} у хвалі й благословлятиму {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} імʼя на віки вічні.
uk.R: Пісня хвали. Її склав Давид. Мій Боже, {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} — Цар! Я розповідатиму, який {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} великий. Я завжди хвалитиму {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} імʼя, на віки вічні.

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: This psalm's title is short and the Hebrew counts it together with the first line as verse 1, so here the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: a praise: a song of praise (tehillah)
decisions.reason: This is the only psalm whose title calls it "a praise" (tehillah). The plural of the same word, tehillim, "praises", is the Hebrew name of the whole book of Psalms.

decisions.choice: Psalm 145: an alphabet poem
decisions.reason: The psalm is an acrostic: its verses begin with the letters of the Hebrew alphabet in order, from aleph (verse 1) to taw (verse 21). The line for the letter nun, which should come after verse 13, is missing from the Hebrew text (see the note on verse 13).

decisions.choice: bless: praise, speak well of
decisions.reason: When people bless God (barakh), they do not give him anything; they praise him and speak of his goodness (103:1).

decisions.choice: A song of praise
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what kind of praise is meant: the psalm is a song.

decisions.choice: My God, you are the King! I will tell how great you are
alternatives: I will exalt you, my God, the King
decisions.reason: Readable turns the title "the King" into a short statement and says what it is to exalt God: to say how great he is.

decisions.choice: "Louange" at Literal for tehillah; "Un chant de louange" at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: This is the only psalm titled tehillah, "a praise". Literal keeps the bare noun; the other levels say it is a song of praise, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "[Một] lời ca ngợi" (L); "Bài ca ngợi" (B, R) for the title tehillah
decisions.reason: The title is not the usual word for a psalm but "a praise" (see the meaning decision); Literal keeps that, and Balanced and Readable say "a song of praise", as the English does, to keep it apart from "thi thiên".

decisions.choice: "다윗의 찬양" (L), "다윗의 찬양 노래" (B, R) for the title tehillah of David
decisions.reason: The Hebrew title names the song a praise (meaning decision); Literal keeps the bare noun and Balanced and Readable say "song of praise", as the English does.

decisions.choice: The whole psalm is in 합쇼체 with "저", also in the verses that speak of the LORD in the third person (3, 8-9, 14, 17-21)
alternatives: the plain style for the third-person verses
decisions.reason: The psalm is one hymn of praise spoken before God, moving between "you" and "he" from verse to verse; changing the speech level each time would break it, so Korean keeps the polite style and simply names the LORD, as in Psalm 138.

decisions.choice: Louvor (L); Cântico de louvor (B, R)
decisions.reason: The title's word is "a praise" (m2), which Literal keeps; Balanced and Readable say it is a song, as the English does. The psalm's praise words are kept apart: "exaltar" for the first verb, "bendizer" for barakh at Literal and Balanced (m4), "louvar" where the English Readable says "praise".

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Psalm 145.
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns and verb forms for God are written plainly.

decisions.choice: tehillah in the title as "ምስጋና" (L), "የምስጋና መዝሙር" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The heading word is "a praise" (meaning decision m2), a word not in the terms list's heading table; Literal keeps the bare noun, Balanced and Readable say "a song of praise" as the English does.

decisions.choice: The alphabet acrostic is not reproduced
alternatives: beginning each verse with the letters of the Ethiopic syllabary
decisions.reason: The verses begin with the Hebrew letters in order (meaning decision m3); Amharic cannot keep that pattern without changing what the lines say, so the meaning is translated and the acrostic is left to the note.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi; the psalm speaks to God with तू and of him with the honorific plural.

decisions.choice: the alphabet pattern is not reproduced
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verses begin with the letters of the alphabet in order (m3). As in Psalms 9-10 and 25 in this translation, and as the English does at every level, the Hindi follows the sense of each verse rather than the Hebrew letters; the meaning decision explains the form.

decisions.choice: स्तुति (L), स्तुति का गीत (B, R); धन्य कहना
decisions.reason: Tehillah is स्तुति; Balanced and Readable say it is a song, as the English does. Blessing God is धन्य कहना, as the poetry note settles; Readable says स्तुति करना where the English says "praise".

decisions.choice: no alphabetic acrostic
alternatives: lines beginning with the letters of the Russian alphabet
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verses begin with the letters of the alphabet in order (m3). As the English does at every level, the Russian translates each line for its sense and does not try to reproduce the pattern, which would bend the wording.

decisions.choice: Хвала (L); Хвалебная песнь (B); Хвалебная песня (R)
decisions.reason: Tehillah is a song of praise (m2): Literal keeps the noun "Хвала", Balanced and Readable say it is a song, with the Psalms' "песнь" (B) and "песня" (R) for shir.

decisions.choice: tehillah ledavid "ダビデの賛美" (L), "賛美。ダビデによる。" (B), "賛美の歌。ダビデによる。" (R)
decisions.reason: Psalter title rule for tehillah (PSA-1: 賛美 L, B; 賛美の歌 R), split as each English level splits the title (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: Acrostic not imitated; 'aromimkha "あがめ" (L), "高くあがめ" (B); va'avarakhah "ほめたたえる" at every level
decisions.reason: Psalter conventions: the alphabet of 145 is not imitated (m3, as PSA-3); barekh with God as object is ほめたたえる (m4); le'olam va'ed "とこしえに、いつまでも" (L, B) through the psalm.

source.text: בְּכָל־י֥וֹם אֲבָרֲכֶ֑ךָּ וַאֲהַלְלָ֥ה שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: In every day I will bless you, and I will praise your name forever and ever.

en.L: Every day I will bless {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and I will praise {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name forever and ever.
en.B: Day after day I will bless {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and give praise to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name for ever and ever.
en.R: I will praise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} every single day. I will keep on praising {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name forever and ever.

fr.L: Chaque jour je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} bénirai, et je louerai {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom à tout jamais.
fr.B: Jour après jour je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} bénirai et je louerai {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom pour toujours et à jamais.
fr.R: Je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louerai chaque jour. Je continuerai de louer {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, pour toujours et à jamais.

sw.L: Kila siku nitakubariki, \q nami nitalisifu jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} milele na milele.
sw.B: Siku baada ya siku nitakubariki \q na kulisifu jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} milele na milele.
sw.R: Nitakusifu kila siku. \q Nitaendelea kulisifu jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} milele na milele.

es.L: Cada día {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} bendeciré, y alabaré {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre por siempre jamás.
es.B: Día tras día {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} bendeciré y alabaré {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre por los siglos de los siglos.
es.R: Te alabaré cada día. Seguiré alabando {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre por siempre jamás.

vi.L: Mỗi ngày tôi sẽ chúc tụng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và tôi sẽ ca ngợi danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời mãi mãi.
vi.B: Ngày qua ngày tôi sẽ chúc tụng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q và ca ngợi danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời mãi mãi.
vi.R: Ngày nào tôi cũng sẽ ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Tôi sẽ cứ ca ngợi danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời mãi mãi.

ko.L: 날마다 제가 주님을 송축하고, \q 주님의 이름을 영원히 그리고 영원토록 찬양하겠습니다.
ko.B: 날마다 제가 주님을 송축하고, \q 영원무궁토록 주님의 이름을 찬양하겠습니다.
ko.R: 저는 하루도 빠짐없이 주님을 찬양하겠습니다. \q 영원히 언제까지나 주님의 이름을 계속 찬양하겠습니다.

pt.L: Todos os dias eu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} bendirei e louvarei o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome para todo o sempre.
pt.B: Dia após dia eu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} bendirei e darei louvor ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome para todo o sempre.
pt.R: Vou {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louvar todos os dias, sem faltar um. Vou continuar louvando o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome para todo o sempre.

am.L: በየቀኑ ሁሉ እባርክሃለሁ፤ \q ስምህንም ለዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም አመሰግናለሁ።
am.B: ዕለት ዕለት እባርክሃለሁ፤ \q ስምህንም ለዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም አወድሳለሁ።
am.R: በየዕለቱ አመሰግንሃለሁ። \q ስምህን ለዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ማመስገኔን እቀጥላለሁ።

hi.L: हर दिन मैं तुझे धन्य कहूँगा, और सदा-सर्वदा तेरे नाम की स्तुति करूँगा।
hi.B: दिन-प्रतिदिन मैं तुझे धन्य कहूँगा और सदा-सर्वदा तेरे नाम की स्तुति करूँगा।
hi.R: मैं हर एक दिन तेरी स्तुति करूँगा। मैं सदा-सर्वदा तेरे नाम की स्तुति करता रहूँगा।

ru.L: Каждый день я буду благословлять {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} и хвалить {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя во веки веков.
ru.B: День за днём я буду благословлять {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} и восхвалять {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя во веки веков.
ru.R: Я буду хвалить {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} каждый день. Я не перестану хвалить {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя во веки веков.

ja.L: 日ごとに、わたしはあなたをほめたたえ、とこしえに、いつまでも、あなたの名を賛美する。
ja.B: 来る日も来る日も、わたしはあなたをほめたたえ、とこしえに、いつまでも、あなたの名を賛美する。
ja.R: わたしは毎日、あなたをほめたたえる。いつまでも、あなたの名を賛美し続ける。

uk.L: Кожного дня я благословлятиму {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} і хвалитиму {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} імʼя навіки-віків.
uk.B: День у день я благословлятиму {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} і віддаватиму хвалу {{deity_pronoun:твоєму|Твоєму}} імені на віки вічні.
uk.R: Я хвалитиму {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} кожнісінький день. Я не перестану хвалити {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} імʼя на віки вічні.

decisions.choice: your name: you as you have made yourself known
decisions.reason: God's name stands for God himself as he has shown who he is (5:12; 9:11).

decisions.choice: praise
decisions.reason: Readable uses "praise" for both verbs, since blessing God means praising him (145:1).

decisions.choice: 'avarakhekka "ほめたたえる" at R too, where the English R says praise
decisions.reason: The Psalter keeps barekh (ほめたたえる) and hallel (賛美する) apart at every level (PSA-1).

source.text: גָּ֘ד֤וֹל יְהוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד וְ֝לִגְדֻלָּת֗וֹ אֵ֣ין חֵֽקֶר׃

records.literal_gloss: Great [is] YHWH and praised exceedingly, and to his greatness there [is] no searching.

en.L: Great [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and to be praised exceedingly, and to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} greatness [there is] no searching.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is great, worthy of the highest praise, and there is no searching out the depth of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} greatness.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is great! He deserves all our praise. No one can ever find the end of how great {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is.

fr.L: Grand [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et digne d’être loué hautement, et à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grandeur [il n’y a] pas d’exploration.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est grand, digne de la plus haute louange, et nul ne peut sonder la profondeur de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grandeur.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est grand ! Il mérite toutes nos louanges. Personne ne pourra jamais trouver la fin de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grandeur.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mkuu na mwenye kusifiwa sana, \q na ukuu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} [hauna] kuchunguzika.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mkuu, anastahili sifa za juu kabisa, \q na hakuna awezaye kuchunguza kina cha ukuu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mkuu! Anastahili sifa zetu zote. \q Hakuna mtu awezaye kufikia mwisho wa ukuu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

es.L: Grande [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} y digno de suprema alabanza, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} grandeza [es] inescrutable.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es grande, digno de la más alta alabanza, y no hay manera de sondear lo profundo de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} grandeza.
es.R: ¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es grande! Merece toda nuestra alabanza. Nadie podrá llegar nunca al final de lo grande que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] vĩ đại và rất đáng được ca ngợi, \q và sự vĩ đại của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [thì] không thể dò xét được.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thật vĩ đại, đáng được ca ngợi tột bậc; \q sự vĩ đại của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sâu thẳm không ai dò thấu.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thật vĩ đại! Ngài đáng được chúng ta hết lòng ca ngợi. \q Không ai có thể tìm ra giới hạn sự vĩ đại của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 위대하시고 크게 찬양받으실 분이시니, \q 그분의 위대하심은 헤아릴 수 없습니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 위대하시고 지극히 높은 찬양을 받으시기에 합당하시니, \q 그분의 위대하심은 아무도 다 헤아릴 수 없습니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 위대하십니다! 그분은 저희의 모든 찬양을 받으셔야 마땅합니다. \q 그분께서 얼마나 위대하신지 아무도 끝까지 알아낼 수 없습니다.

pt.L: Grande [é] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e sumamente digno de louvor, e para a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} grandeza não [há] sondagem.
pt.B: Grande é {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, digno do mais alto louvor, e a profundidade da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} grandeza não se pode sondar.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é grande! Ele merece todo o nosso louvor. Ninguém jamais vai encontrar o fim da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} grandeza.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ታላቅ [ነው]፤ እጅግም ሊመሰገን የሚገባው [ነው]፤ \q ለታላቅነቱም ፍለጋ የለውም።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ታላቅ ነው፤ ምስጋና ሁሉ ይገባዋል፤ \q የታላቅነቱን ጥልቀት መርምሮ የሚደርስበት የለም።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ታላቅ ነው! ምስጋናችን ሁሉ ይገባዋል። \q ታላቅነቱ ምን ያህል እንደ ሆነ ማንም ፈጽሞ ሊደርስበት አይችልም።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} महान और अति स्तुति के योग्य [हैं], और उनकी महानता की कोई थाह [नहीं]।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} महान हैं, सबसे ऊँची स्तुति के योग्य, और उनकी महानता की गहराई की थाह कोई नहीं ले सकता।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} महान हैं! वे हमारी सारी स्तुति के योग्य हैं। कोई कभी नहीं जान सकता कि वे कितने महान हैं।

ru.L: Велик {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} и весьма достоин хвалы, и величию {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} нет исследования.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} велик, достоин самой высокой хвалы, и глубину {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} величия невозможно исследовать.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} велик! Он достоин всей нашей хвалы. Никто никогда не сможет понять до конца, как {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} велик.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は大いなる方、大いに賛美されるべき方。その偉大さは究めることができない。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は偉大な方、大いに賛美されるにふさわしい方。その偉大さの深みを、探り尽くすことはできない。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は偉大な方だ！わたしたちのすべての賛美を受けるにふさわしい。その方がどれほど偉大か、だれにも知り尽くすことはできない。

uk.L: Великий {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} і гідний найвищої хвали, і {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} величі немає дослідження.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} великий, гідний найвищої хвали, і глибини {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} величі не дослідити.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} великий! Він гідний усієї нашої хвали. Ніхто ніколи не знайде меж того, який {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} великий.

decisions.choice: praised exceedingly: deserving to be praised highly
decisions.reason: The form (mehullal) is "praised"; it can say that he is praised or that he is to be praised. The same line stands in 48:2 and 96:4.

decisions.choice: there is no searching: it can never be fully explored
decisions.reason: Nothing is beyond his greatness: no search can reach its limit (Job 11:7; Isaiah 40:28).

decisions.choice: No one can ever find the end of how great he is
decisions.reason: Readable says what the idiom means (m2).

decisions.choice: Grande [é] o SENHOR (L); Grande é o SENHOR (B)
decisions.reason: The line opens the praise of the psalm, as in 48:2 and 96:4 (m1), so Balanced keeps the Hebrew order and begins with "Grande", as Literal does; Readable says it plainly, "O SENHOR é grande!", as 48:2 does at Readable.

decisions.choice: "ታላቅ [ነው]፤ እጅግም ሊመሰገን የሚገባው [ነው]" (L), "ምስጋና ሁሉ ይገባዋል" (B), "ምስጋናችን ሁሉ ይገባዋል" (R)
decisions.reason: The same line stands in 48:2 (meaning decision m1); its Amharic on main is kept at each level.

decisions.choice: umehullal me'od "大いに賛美されるべき方" (L), "…にふさわしい方" (B, R); 'ein cheqer "究めることができない" (L), "探り尽くすことはできない" (B), "知り尽くすことはできない" (R)
decisions.reason: Deserving to be praised highly (m1); 'no searching' is that it can never be fully explored (m2). The passive 賛美される here is a true passive (God is praised), not a respect form.

source.text: דּ֣וֹר לְ֭דוֹר יְשַׁבַּ֣ח מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וּגְב֖וּרֹתֶ֣יךָ יַגִּֽידוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Generation to generation will laud your works, and your mighty deeds they will declare.

en.L: Generation to generation will laud {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} works, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} mighty deeds they will declare.
en.B: Each generation will praise {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} works to the one after it and announce {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} mighty acts.
en.R: Parents will tell their children about the things {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done. They will tell about {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} powerful acts.

fr.L: Génération à génération vantera {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} œuvres, et {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} hauts faits, ils les annonceront.
fr.B: Chaque génération célébrera {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} œuvres devant la suivante et annoncera {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} actes puissants.
fr.R: Les parents raconteront à leurs enfants ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait. Ils parleront de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} actions puissantes.

sw.L: Kizazi kwa kizazi kitazisifu kazi {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, \q na matendo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} makuu watayatangaza.
sw.B: Kila kizazi kitazisifu kazi {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} kwa kizazi kinachofuata \q na kuyatangaza matendo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} makuu.
sw.R: Wazazi watawaambia watoto wao mambo uliyoyatenda. \q Watasimulia matendo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yenye nguvu.

es.L: Generación a generación celebrará {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} obras, y {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} hechos poderosos anunciarán.
es.B: Cada generación alabará {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} obras ante la siguiente y anunciará {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} hechos poderosos.
es.R: Los padres les contarán a sus hijos las cosas que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho. Hablarán de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} hechos poderosos.

vi.L: Đời này sang đời kia sẽ ca tụng các công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và chúng sẽ rao truyền những việc quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Thế hệ này sẽ ca tụng công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho thế hệ sau, \q và công bố những việc quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Cha mẹ sẽ kể cho con cái nghe những việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm. \q Họ sẽ kể về những việc quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 대대로 주님께서 하신 일들을 기리고, \q 주님의 능하신 일들을 전할 것입니다.
ko.B: 한 세대가 다음 세대에게 주님께서 하신 일들을 찬양하고, \q 주님의 능하신 일들을 알릴 것입니다.
ko.R: 부모들은 주님께서 하신 일들을 자녀들에게 들려줄 것입니다. \q 주님께서 하신 놀라운 능력의 일들을 이야기할 것입니다.

pt.L: Geração a geração exaltará as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} obras, e os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} feitos poderosos anunciarão.
pt.B: Cada geração louvará as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} obras à geração seguinte e anunciará os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} atos poderosos.
pt.R: Os pais vão contar aos filhos as coisas que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste. Vão falar dos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} atos poderosos.

am.L: ትውልድ ለትውልድ ሥራዎችህን ያወድሳል፤ \q ብርቱ ሥራዎችህንም ይናገራሉ።
am.B: እያንዳንዱ ትውልድ ሥራዎችህን ለሚቀጥለው ትውልድ ያወድሳል፤ \q ብርቱ ሥራዎችህንም ያውጃል።
am.R: ወላጆች ያደረግሃቸውን ነገሮች ለልጆቻቸው ይነግራሉ። \q ስለ ኃያል ሥራዎችህ ይናገራሉ።

hi.L: पीढ़ी से पीढ़ी तेरे कामों की सराहना करेगी, और वे तेरे पराक्रम के कामों का बखान करेंगे।
hi.B: हर पीढ़ी अपने बाद की पीढ़ी के सामने तेरे कामों की स्तुति करेगी और तेरे पराक्रम के कामों का प्रचार करेगी।
hi.R: माता-पिता अपने बच्चों को उन कामों के बारे में बताएँगे जो तूने किए हैं। वे तेरे सामर्थ्य के कामों के बारे में बताएँगे।

ru.L: Род роду будет восхвалять {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} дела, и о {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} могучих деяниях будут возвещать.
ru.B: Каждое поколение будет восхвалять {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} дела перед следующим и возвещать о {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} могучих деяниях.
ru.R: Родители будут рассказывать детям о том, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} сделал. Они будут рассказывать о {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} великих делах.

ja.L: 代から代へと、[人々は]あなたのみわざをたたえ、あなたの力あるわざを告げる。
ja.B: 世代から世代へと、人々はあなたのみわざをたたえ、あなたの力あるわざを語り伝える。
ja.R: 親は子どもたちに、あなたがなさったことを話して、たたえる。あなたの力あるわざを語り伝える。

uk.L: Рід родові вихвалятиме {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} діла, і {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} могутні вчинки вони звіщатимуть.
uk.B: Кожне покоління вихвалятиме {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} діла перед наступним і звіщатиме {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} могутні вчинки.
uk.R: Батьки розповідатимуть своїм дітям про те, що {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} зробив. Вони розповідатимуть про {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} могутні діла.

decisions.choice: laud: praise aloud
decisions.reason: The verb (shibbach) means to praise or extol; with "to generation" it pictures each generation praising God's works to the one that follows (78:4).

decisions.choice: mighty deeds: acts of power
decisions.reason: The word (gevurot) is acts that show strength, such as God's acts of rescue for Israel (106:2).

decisions.choice: Parents will tell their children
decisions.reason: Readable makes the passing on from one generation to the next concrete: older people telling younger ones.

decisions.choice: yeshabbach "たたえ"; gevurotekha "力あるわざ"
decisions.reason: shibbach is たたえる, kept apart from hallel and barekh (PSA-7); R follows the English R's parents and children (r-en-1).

source.text: הֲ֭דַר כְּב֣וֹד הוֹדֶ֑ךָ וְדִבְרֵ֖י נִפְלְאוֹתֶ֣יךָ אָשִֽׂיחָה׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] splendor of [the] glory of your majesty and [the] matters of your wonders I will meditate on.

en.L: The splendor of the glory of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} majesty, and the matters of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wonders, I will meditate on.
en.B: I will reflect on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} majesty, its glory and splendor, and on the story of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wonders.
en.R: I will think about how glorious and majestic {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are. I will think about the amazing things {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done.

fr.L: La splendeur de la gloire de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} majesté, et les récits de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} merveilles, je les méditerai.
fr.B: Je méditerai sur {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} majesté, sa gloire et sa splendeur, et sur le récit de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} merveilles.
fr.R: Je penserai à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} gloire et à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} majesté. Je penserai aux choses étonnantes que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as faites.

sw.L: Fahari ya utukufu wa enzi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, \q na habari za maajabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, nitazitafakari.
sw.B: Nitaitafakari enzi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, utukufu wake \q na fahari yake, na habari za maajabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Nitafikiri jinsi ulivyo mtukufu na mwenye enzi. \q Nitafikiri juu ya mambo ya ajabu uliyoyatenda.

es.L: El esplendor de la gloria de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} majestad, y los relatos de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} maravillas, meditaré.
es.B: Reflexionaré en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} majestad, en su gloria y su esplendor, y en la historia de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} maravillas.
es.R: Pensaré en lo glorioso y majestuoso que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres. Pensaré en las cosas asombrosas que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho.

vi.L: Sự huy hoàng của vinh quang uy nghi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q và các sự kỳ diệu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tôi sẽ suy gẫm.
vi.B: Tôi sẽ suy gẫm về sự uy nghi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, về vinh quang và vẻ huy hoàng của sự uy nghi ấy, \q và về câu chuyện những việc kỳ diệu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Tôi sẽ suy nghĩ về việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vinh hiển và uy nghi biết bao. \q Tôi sẽ suy nghĩ về những việc kỳ diệu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm.

ko.L: 주님의 위엄의 영광스러운 광채와 주님의 기이한 일들의 말씀을 제가 \q 깊이 묵상하겠습니다.
ko.B: 제가 주님의 위엄과 그 영광과 광채를, \q 그리고 주님의 기이한 일들의 이야기를 곰곰이 생각하겠습니다.
ko.R: 저는 주님께서 얼마나 영광스럽고 위엄이 있으신지 생각하겠습니다. \q 주님께서 하신 놀라운 일들을 생각하겠습니다.

pt.L: O esplendor da glória da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} majestade, e as coisas das {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} maravilhas, meditarei.
pt.B: Vou refletir sobre a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} majestade, a sua glória e o seu esplendor, e sobre a história das {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} maravilhas.
pt.R: Vou pensar em como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és glorioso e majestoso. Vou pensar nas coisas maravilhosas que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste.

am.L: የግርማህን ክብር ውበት፣ \q የድንቅ ሥራዎችህንም ነገር አሰላስላለሁ።
am.B: ግርማህን፣ ክብሩንና ውበቱን፣ \q የድንቅ ሥራዎችህንም ታሪክ አሰላስላለሁ።
am.R: ምን ያህል ክቡርና ግርማዊ እንደ ሆንክ አስባለሁ። \q ያደረግሃቸውን አስደናቂ ነገሮች አስባለሁ።

hi.L: तेरे प्रताप की महिमा का वैभव, और तेरे आश्चर्यकर्मों की बातें, मैं उन पर ध्यान करूँगा।
hi.B: मैं तेरे प्रताप पर, उसकी महिमा और वैभव पर, और तेरे आश्चर्यकर्मों के वृत्तांत पर मनन करूँगा।
hi.R: मैं इस बारे में सोचूँगा कि तू कितना महिमामय और प्रतापी है। मैं उन अद्भुत कामों के बारे में सोचूँगा जो तूने किए हैं।

ru.L: О великолепии славы {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} величия и о делах {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} чудес я буду размышлять.
ru.B: Я буду размышлять о {{deity_pronoun:твоём|Твоём}} величии, его славе и великолепии, и о рассказах о {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} чудесах.
ru.R: Я буду думать о том, как {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} славен и велик. Я буду думать об удивительных делах, которые {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} совершил.

ja.L: あなたの威光の栄光の輝きと、あなたの奇しいみわざの事柄を、わたしは思いめぐらす。
ja.B: あなたの威光の栄光と輝きを、また、あなたの不思議なみわざの物語を、わたしは思いめぐらす。
ja.R: わたしは、あなたがどれほど栄光に満ち、威厳のある方かを、よく考える。あなたがなさった驚くべきことを、よく考える。

uk.L: Пишноту слави {{deity_pronoun:твоєї|Твоєї}} величності і справи {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} див я розважатиму.
uk.B: Я роздумуватиму про {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} величність, її славу й пишноту, і про розповідь про {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} дива.
uk.R: Я думатиму про те, який {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} славний і величний. Я думатиму про дивовижні речі, які {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} зробив.

decisions.choice: the splendor of the glory of your majesty: your glorious and majestic splendor
decisions.reason: Three words for greatness are piled up (hadar, kavod, hod) to say that God's majesty is beyond words.

decisions.choice: the matters of your wonders: your wonderful works and the words that tell them
decisions.reason: The word (devarim) can mean words or matters. Here it may be the accounts of God's wonders, or simply the wonders themselves.

decisions.choice: meditate: think over, perhaps aloud
decisions.reason: The verb (siach) means to think something through and also to talk about it (77:13; 105:2).

decisions.choice: I will meditate: the Hebrew text
alternatives: they will speak (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text has "I will meditate". The ancient Greek translation has "they will speak" in the first half and "they will tell" in the second, as in verses 6 and 11. The renderings follow the Hebrew text.

decisions.choice: divrei nifle'otekha "奇しいみわざの事柄" (L), "不思議なみわざの物語" (B), "驚くべきこと" (R); 'asichah "思いめぐらす" (L, B), "よく考える" (R)
decisions.reason: nifle'ot as 26:7 and siach as Psalm 119 (PSA-3, PSA-13); the 'matters' are the works and the words that tell them (m2, uncertain); the Hebrew text 'I will meditate' is kept (m4, uncertain).

source.text: וֶעֱז֣וּז נוֹרְאֹתֶ֣יךָ יֹאמֵ֑רוּ וּגְדוּלָּתְךָ֥ אֲסַפְּרֶֽנָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] might of your awesome [deeds] they will tell, and your greatness I will recount it.

en.L: And the might of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} awesome [deeds] they will tell, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} greatness, I will recount it.
en.B: People will speak of the power of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} fearsome deeds, and I will tell of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} greatness.
en.R: People will talk about the powerful and frightening things {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done, and I will tell how great {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are.

fr.L: Et la puissance de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} [actes] redoutables, ils la diront, et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} grandeur, moi, je la raconterai.
fr.B: On parlera de la puissance de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} actes redoutables, et moi, je raconterai {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} grandeur.
fr.R: Les gens parleront des choses puissantes et terribles que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as faites, et moi, je dirai combien {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es grand.

sw.L: Na nguvu za [matendo] {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ya kutisha wataisimulia, \q na ukuu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, nitautangaza.
sw.B: Watu watazungumza juu ya nguvu za matendo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ya kutisha, \q nami nitatangaza ukuu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.R: Watu watazungumza juu ya mambo yenye nguvu na ya kutisha uliyoyatenda, \q nami nitawaambia jinsi ulivyo mkuu.

es.L: Y el poder de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} [obras] temibles dirán, y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} grandeza, yo la contaré.
es.B: La gente hablará del poder de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} obras temibles, y yo contaré {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} grandeza.
es.R: La gente hablará de las cosas poderosas y temibles que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho, y yo contaré lo grande que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres.

vi.L: Và người ta sẽ nói về quyền năng của những [việc] đáng sợ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và sự vĩ đại của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tôi sẽ thuật lại.
vi.B: Người ta sẽ nói về quyền năng của những việc đáng kinh sợ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và tôi sẽ thuật lại sự vĩ đại của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Người ta sẽ nói về những việc mạnh mẽ và đáng sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm, \q và tôi sẽ kể ra {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vĩ đại biết bao.

ko.L: 그리고 사람들이 주님의 두려운 [일들]의 능력을 말하고, \q 주님의 위대하심을 제가 전하겠습니다.
ko.B: 사람들은 주님께서 행하신 두려운 일들의 능력을 말하고, \q 저는 주님의 위대하심을 전하겠습니다.
ko.R: 사람들은 주님께서 하신 힘 있고 두려운 일들을 이야기하고, \q 저는 주님께서 얼마나 위대하신지 전하겠습니다.

pt.L: E o poder dos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} [feitos] temíveis dirão, e a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} grandeza, eu a contarei.
pt.B: As pessoas falarão do poder dos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} feitos temíveis, e eu contarei a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} grandeza.
pt.R: As pessoas vão falar das coisas poderosas e assustadoras que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste, e eu vou contar como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és grande.

am.L: የአስፈሪ ሥራዎችህንም ብርታት ይናገራሉ፤ \q ታላቅነትህንም እኔ እተርከዋለሁ።
am.B: ሰዎች ስለ አስፈሪ ሥራዎችህ ኃይል ይናገራሉ፤ \q እኔም ስለ ታላቅነትህ እናገራለሁ።
am.R: ሰዎች ስላደረግሃቸው ኃይለኛና አስፈሪ ነገሮች ያወራሉ፤ \q እኔም ምን ያህል ታላቅ እንደ ሆንክ እናገራለሁ።

hi.L: और लोग तेरे भयानक [कामों] के सामर्थ्य की चर्चा करेंगे, और तेरी महानता, मैं उसका वर्णन करूँगा।
hi.B: लोग तेरे भय जगानेवाले कामों के सामर्थ्य की चर्चा करेंगे, और मैं तेरी महानता का वर्णन करूँगा।
hi.R: लोग उन सामर्थी और डरा देनेवाले कामों के बारे में बात करेंगे जो तूने किए हैं, और मैं बताऊँगा कि तू कितना महान है।

ru.L: И о силе {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} грозных [дел] будут говорить, и {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} величие — я буду пересказывать его.
ru.B: Люди будут говорить о силе {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} грозных дел, а я буду рассказывать о {{deity_pronoun:твоём|Твоём}} величии.
ru.R: Люди будут говорить о могучих и страшных делах, которые {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} совершил, а я буду рассказывать, как {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} велик.

ja.L: そして[人々は]、あなたの恐るべきわざの力を語り、わたしは、あなたの偉大さを語り告げる。
ja.B: 人々は、あなたの畏るべきみわざの力を語り、わたしは、あなたの偉大さを語り伝える。
ja.R: 人々は、あなたがなさった力強く、おそれるべきことについて話し、わたしは、あなたがどれほど偉大な方かを話す。

uk.L: І про силу {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} страшних [діл] вони говоритимуть, і {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} велич — я розповідатиму про неї.
uk.B: Люди говоритимуть про силу {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} грізних діл, а я розповідатиму про {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} велич.
uk.R: Люди говоритимуть про могутні й грізні речі, які {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} зробив, а я розповідатиму, який {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} великий.

decisions.choice: your greatness: the words follow the form to be read
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text writes this word in one form and its notes say to read it in another; the written form is plural, "your great deeds", and the form to be read is singular, "your greatness". The renderings follow the form to be read; the meaning is nearly the same.

decisions.choice: your awesome deeds: deeds that make people afraid
decisions.reason: The word (nora'ot) is from the verb "fear": things so great that they cause awe and dread, like the acts at the Exodus (Deuteronomy 10:21).

decisions.choice: they: people in general
decisions.reason: "They" is anyone who sees God's works, as in verse 4. The psalmist joins them ("I will recount").

decisions.choice: People
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name who "they" are (m3).

decisions.choice: लोग
decisions.reason: Hindi needs a subject for "they will tell"; लोग is the plain way to say people in general (m3), as Balanced and Readable say it too.

decisions.choice: nor'otekha "恐るべきわざ" (L), "畏るべきみわざ" (B), "おそれるべきこと" (R); gedullatekha singular "偉大さ"
decisions.reason: nora' as 76:8 (PSA-8); 'your greatness' follows the form to be read (m1, uncertain).

source.text: זֵ֣כֶר רַב־טוּבְךָ֣ יַבִּ֑יעוּ וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] remembrance of [the] abundance of your goodness they will pour forth, and [of] your righteousness they will shout for joy.

en.L: The memory of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} abundant goodness they will pour forth, and [of] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} righteousness they will shout for joy.
en.B: They will spill over with the memory of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} great goodness and sing out for joy at {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} righteousness.
en.R: People will remember how very good {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are, and they will not be able to stop talking about it. They will sing happily about how {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} always do what is right.

fr.L: Le souvenir de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} grande bonté, ils le feront jaillir, et [de] {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} justice ils crieront de joie.
fr.B: Ils déborderont du souvenir de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} grande bonté et chanteront avec joie {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} justice.
fr.R: Les gens se souviendront combien {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es bon, et ils ne pourront pas s’arrêter d’en parler. Ils chanteront avec joie que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais toujours ce qui est juste.

sw.L: Kumbukumbu ya wingi wa wema {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wataibubujisha, \q na [juu ya] haki {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} watapiga kelele za furaha.
sw.B: Watafurika kwa kumbukumbu ya wema {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mwingi \q na kuimba kwa furaha juu ya haki {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Watu watakumbuka jinsi ulivyo mwema sana, nao hawataweza kuacha kuzungumza juu ya hilo. \q Wataimba kwa furaha juu ya jinsi unavyotenda yaliyo haki daima.

es.L: El recuerdo de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} abundante bondad proclamarán a raudales, y [de] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} justicia gritarán de alegría.
es.B: Desbordarán con el recuerdo de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} gran bondad y cantarán con alegría por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} justicia.
es.R: La gente recordará lo bueno que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres, y no podrá dejar de hablar de ello. Cantarán felices de cómo {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} siempre haces lo correcto.

vi.L: Kỷ niệm về sự tốt lành dư dật của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, chúng sẽ tuôn tràn ra, \q và [về] sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, chúng sẽ reo hò vui mừng.
vi.B: Người ta sẽ tuôn tràn lời nhắc lại sự tốt lành lớn lao của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và reo hò vui mừng vì sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Người ta sẽ nhớ lại {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tốt lành biết bao, và họ sẽ nói về điều đó mãi không thôi. \q Họ sẽ vui vẻ ca hát về việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} luôn làm điều công chính.

ko.L: 그들이 주님의 크신 선하심을 기억하여 쏟아 내고, \q 주님의 의를 기뻐 외칠 것입니다.
ko.B: 그들은 주님의 크신 선하심을 기억하며 넘치도록 말하고, \q 주님의 의를 기뻐 노래할 것입니다.
ko.R: 사람들은 주님께서 얼마나 좋으신 분인지 기억하고, 그 이야기를 멈추지 못할 것입니다. \q 주님께서 언제나 옳은 일을 하시는 것을 기뻐하며 노래할 것입니다.

pt.L: A memória da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} grande bondade derramarão, e [da] {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} justiça cantarão de alegria.
pt.B: Eles transbordarão com a lembrança da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} imensa bondade e cantarão de alegria pela {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} justiça.
pt.R: As pessoas vão se lembrar de como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és bom, e não vão conseguir parar de falar disso. Vão cantar felizes sobre como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sempre fazes o que é certo.

am.L: የቸርነትህን ብዛት መታሰቢያ ያፈልቃሉ፤ \q በጽድቅህም እልል ይላሉ።
am.B: የታላቅ ቸርነትህ ትዝታ ከአፋቸው ይፈልቃል፤ \q ስለ ጽድቅህም በደስታ ይዘምራሉ።
am.R: ሰዎች ምን ያህል ቸር እንደ ሆንክ ያስታውሳሉ፤ ስለዚያም ማውራት ማቆም አይችሉም። \q ሁልጊዜ ትክክል የሆነውን እንደምታደርግ በደስታ ይዘምራሉ።

hi.L: वे तेरी बड़ी भलाई का स्मरण उमड़ाएँगे, और तेरी धार्मिकता [का] जयजयकार करेंगे।
hi.B: तेरी बड़ी भलाई की याद से वे उमड़ पड़ेंगे और तेरी धार्मिकता पर आनंद से गा उठेंगे।
hi.R: लोग याद करेंगे कि तू कितना भला है, और वे उसके बारे में बोलना बंद नहीं कर पाएँगे। वे आनंद से गाएँगे कि तू सदा वही करता है जो सही है।

ru.L: Память о {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} великой благости будут изливать, и о {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} праведности будут ликовать.
ru.B: Они будут переполнены воспоминаниями о {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} великой доброте и с радостью воспевать {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} праведность.
ru.R: Люди будут вспоминать, как {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} добр, и не смогут перестать говорить об этом. Они будут радостно петь о том, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} всегда поступаешь справедливо.

ja.L: [人々は]あなたの豊かな恵み深さの記憶をあふれ出させ、あなたの義を喜び歌う。
ja.B: 人々は、あなたの大いなる恵み深さを思い起こして、あふれるように語り、あなたの義を喜び歌う。
ja.R: 人々は、あなたがどんなに良い方かを思い出して、そのことを話さずにはいられない。あなたがいつも正しいことをなさることを、喜んで歌う。

uk.L: Памʼять про {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} велику доброту вони виливатимуть, і [про] {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} праведність радісно співатимуть.
uk.B: Вони переповнюватимуться спогадом про {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} велику доброту і радісно співатимуть про {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} праведність.
uk.R: Люди памʼятатимуть, який {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} дуже добрий, і не зможуть перестати про це говорити. Вони радісно співатимуть про те, що {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} завжди чиниш правильно.

decisions.choice: remembrance: the memory and the telling of it
decisions.reason: The word (zekher) is a memory kept alive by being spoken about.

decisions.choice: pour forth: bubble over, speak freely
decisions.reason: The verb (nava') is used of a spring gushing water (Proverbs 18:4) and of words that pour out (19:3).

decisions.choice: righteousness: God doing what is right
decisions.reason: God's righteousness (tsedaqah) is his faithfulness to do what is right, which often means rescuing his people (71:15).

decisions.choice: they will not be able to stop talking about it
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of a spring that overflows (m2).

decisions.choice: how you always do what is right
decisions.reason: Readable says what righteousness means here (m3).

decisions.choice: उमड़ाना (L); उमड़ पड़ना (B)
decisions.reason: The verb pictures a spring gushing water (m2); Hindi उमड़ना keeps the picture of words overflowing. Readable says what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: rav-tuvekha "豊かな恵み深さ" (L), "大いなる恵み深さ" (B); yabbi'u "あふれ出させ" (L), "あふれるように語り" (B), "話さずにはいられない" (R); tsidqatekha "義" (L, B)
decisions.reason: tuv of God 恵み深さ (PSA-3); the verb is speech bubbling over (m2); R follows the English R (r-en-1, r-en-2).

source.text: חַנּ֣וּן וְרַח֣וּם יְהוָ֑ה אֶ֥רֶךְ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם וּגְדָל־חָֽסֶד׃

records.literal_gloss: Gracious and compassionate [is] YHWH, long of anger and great of loyal love.

en.L: Gracious and compassionate [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, slow to anger and great in loyal love.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is full of grace and compassion, slow to anger and great in loyal love.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is kind and tender. He does not get angry quickly, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful love is great.

fr.L: Bienveillant et plein de compassion [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, lent à la colère et grand en amour loyal.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est plein de grâce et de compassion, lent à la colère et riche en amour fidèle.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est bon et tendre. Il ne se met pas vite en colère, et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle est grand.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mwenye neema na mwenye huruma, \q mwenye kuchelewa kukasirika na mkuu katika upendo usiokoma.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amejaa neema na huruma; \q huchelewa kukasirika na ni mkuu katika upendo usiokoma.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mwema na mpole. \q Hakasiriki upesi, na upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma ni mkuu.

es.L: Clemente y compasivo [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, lento para la ira y grande en amor leal.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está lleno de gracia y compasión, es lento para la ira y grande en amor fiel.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es bondadoso y tierno. No se enoja fácilmente, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel es grande.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] Đấng đầy ân điển và thương xót, \q chậm giận và giàu tình yêu thương thành tín.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đầy ân điển và lòng thương xót, \q chậm giận và giàu tình yêu thương thành tín.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nhân từ và dịu dàng. Ngài không dễ nổi giận, \q và tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật lớn lao.

ko.L: 은혜로우시고 긍휼이 많으신 분이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시니, \q 노하기를 오래 참으시고 한결같은 사랑이 크십니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 은혜와 긍휼이 가득하시고, \q 쉽게 노하지 않으시며, 한결같은 사랑이 크십니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 친절하시고 다정하십니다. \q 쉽게 화내지 않으시고, 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 큽니다.

pt.L: Misericordioso e compassivo [é] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, longo de ira e grande em amor leal.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é misericordioso e compassivo, lento para se irar e grande em amor leal.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é cheio de bondade e de compaixão. Ele demora a ficar irado, e o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor fiel é grande.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ቸርና ርኅሩኅ [ነው]፤ \q ለቁጣ የዘገየ፣ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ታላቅ [የሆነ]።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸጋ የሞላውና ርኅሩኅ ነው፤ \q ቶሎ የማይቆጣ፣ በጽኑ ፍቅርም ታላቅ ነው።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ቸርና የሚራራ ነው። \q ቶሎ አይቆጣም፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ታላቅ ነው።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अनुग्रहकारी और दयालु [हैं], कोप करने में धीरजवंत और अटल प्रेम में महान।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अनुग्रह और कोमल करुणा से भरे हैं, क्रोध करने में धीमे और अटल प्रेम में महान।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कृपालु और दयालु हैं। वे जल्दी क्रोधित नहीं होते, और उनका अटल प्रेम महान है।

ru.L: Милостив и сострадателен {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, долгий на гнев и великий в неизменной любви.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} полон милости и сострадания, медленный на гнев, богатый неизменной любовью.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} добр и полон нежного сострадания. Он не спешит гневаться. Его неизменная любовь велика.

ja.L: 恵み深く、あわれみ深い、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は。怒るのに遅く、大いなる誠実をもっておられる。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は恵みとあわれみに満ちた方、怒るのに遅く、変わらぬいつくしみに富んでおられる。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、やさしく、思いやりのある方だ。なかなかお怒りにならない。その方の変わらぬいつくしみは大きい。

uk.L: Милостивий і милосердний {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, повільний до гніву й великий у незмінній любові.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сповнений милості й милосердя, повільний до гніву й великий у незмінній любові.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} добрий і ніжний. Він не гнівається швидко, і {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} вірна любов велика.

decisions.choice: Exodus 34:6
decisions.reason: The LORD's description of himself to Moses (Exodus 34:6), repeated through the Bible (86:15; 103:8; Joel 2; Jonah 4:2).

decisions.choice: long of anger: slow to become angry
decisions.reason: Anger was pictured by the nose (the same word, 'af), and a "long" nose is anger that is slow to rise.

decisions.choice: loyal love: chesed
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is love that keeps faith, the commitment God has bound himself to toward his people (Exodus 34:6-7). Literal and Balanced say "loyal love".

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

decisions.choice: kind and tender
decisions.reason: Readable uses plain words for the two qualities: grace that gives freely and the tender love of a parent (raham is related to the word for the womb).

decisions.choice: "ân điển và thương xót" (L, B); "nhân từ và dịu dàng" (R)
alternatives: "nhân từ và thương xót" at every level
decisions.reason: The words recall God's name in Exodus 34:6 (see the meaning decision). "ân điển" is the key term for grace; Readable says it in plain words, as the English Readable says "kind and tender".

decisions.choice: "은혜로우시고 긍휼이 많으신" for gracious and compassionate
decisions.reason: The words of Exodus 34:6 (meaning decision); "긍휼" is kept for this word (also verse 9) and "자비" for asking mercy.

decisions.choice: misericordioso e compassivo, longo de ira (L) / lento para se irar (B), grande em amor leal; R: bondade, compaixão, demora a ficar irado
decisions.reason: The LORD's words of Exodus 34:6 (m1), in that verse's Portuguese and as Psalms 86:15 and 103:8 have them: "compassivo" for rachum, "misericordioso" for chanun, here in the Hebrew order of this verse, which names grace first. Readable says "amor fiel", as 103:8 does at Readable.

decisions.choice: The words of Exodus 34:6 as on main: "ርኅሩኅ", "ቸር" (L) / "ጸጋ የሞላው" (B), "ለቁጣ የዘገየ" (L) / "ቶሎ የማይቆጣ" (B, R), "ጽኑ ፍቅር"
decisions.reason: The line repeats the LORD's words to Moses (meaning decision m1), and the Amharic keeps the Exodus 34:6 wording (and 86:15). Two things follow this psalm's Hebrew: "gracious" comes first, and the love is "great" (gedol), not "abundant" (rav), so "ታላቅ" stands where Exodus has "የበዛ" / "የበለጸገ".

decisions.choice: the words of Exodus 34:6
decisions.reason: The line takes up the LORD's description of himself in Exodus 34:6 (m1), so Hindi uses that verse's words at each level in this translation (अनुग्रहकारी, दयालु, कोप करने में धीरजवंत, अटल प्रेम), in the Hebrew order of this psalm.

decisions.choice: милостив и сострадателен; долгий на гнев (L), медленный на гнев (B); неизменная любовь
decisions.reason: The confession of Exodus 34:6 (m1) keeps its wording in this translation (Exodus 34:6, Psalm 103:8) at each level; the Hebrew here puts "gracious" first, so "милостив" comes first too.

decisions.choice: channun verachum … 'erekh 'appayim ugdol-chased in the words of 103:8 / 111:4: "恵み深く、あわれみ深い" / "怒るのに遅く" (L), "恵みとあわれみに満ちた方" / "変わらぬいつくしみに富んで" (B), "やさしく、思いやりのある" / "なかなかお怒りにならない" (R)
decisions.reason: The Exodus 34:6 formula (m1) is worded as in 86:15 and 103:8, in this verse's order channun first as 111:4; gedol-chesed 'great in loyal love' "大いなる誠実" (L) where 103:8 has rav-chesed 富んで.

source.text: טוֹב־יְהוָ֥ה לַכֹּ֑ל וְ֝רַחֲמָ֗יו עַל־כָּל־מַעֲשָֽׂיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Good [is] YHWH to all, and his compassions [are] over all his works.

en.L: Good [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to all, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} compassions [are] over all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} works.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is good to everyone; {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} compassion covers all that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has made.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is good to everyone. He shows tender love to everything {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has made.

fr.L: Bon [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} envers tous, et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} compassions [sont] sur toutes {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} œuvres.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est bon envers tous ; {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} compassion s’étend sur tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est bon pour tout le monde. Il montre un amour tendre à tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mwema kwa wote, \q na huruma {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} [ziko] juu ya kazi {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zote.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mwema kwa kila mtu; \q huruma {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} inavifunika vyote alivyoviumba.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mwema kwa kila mtu. \q Huonyesha upendo mwororo kwa kila kitu alichokiumba.

es.L: Bueno [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} con todos, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} compasión [está] sobre todas {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} obras.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es bueno con todos; {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} compasión alcanza a todo lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es bueno con todos. Muestra amor tierno a todo lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] tốt lành với mọi người, \q và lòng thương xót của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [ở] trên mọi công việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tốt lành với mọi người; \q lòng thương xót của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bao trùm mọi loài {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dựng nên.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tốt lành với mọi người. \q Ngài bày tỏ tình thương dịu dàng với mọi vật {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dựng nên.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 모두에게 선하시고, \q 그분의 긍휼이 그분께서 지으신 모든 것 위에 있습니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 모든 이에게 선하시니, \q 그분의 긍휼이 그분께서 지으신 모든 것을 덮습니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 모든 이에게 좋으신 분이십니다. \q 그분께서 만드신 모든 것에게 다정한 사랑을 베푸십니다.

pt.L: Bom [é] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} para todos, e as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} compaixões [estão] sobre todas as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} obras.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é bom para todos; a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} compaixão alcança tudo o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é bom para todos. Ele mostra amor e carinho por tudo o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለሁሉ መልካም [ነው]፤ \q ርኅራኄውም በሥራዎቹ ሁሉ ላይ [ነው]።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለሁሉም መልካም ነው፤ \q ርኅራኄው የፈጠረውን ሁሉ ይሸፍናል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለሁሉም መልካም ነው። \q ለፈጠረው ሁሉ ርኅሩኅ ፍቅሩን ያሳያል።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} सब के लिए भले [हैं], और उनकी करुणा उनके सब कामों पर [है]।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} सब के प्रति भले हैं; उनकी करुणा उनकी बनाई हर वस्तु पर छाई रहती है।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} सब के प्रति भले हैं। उन्होंने जो कुछ बनाया है, उस सब पर वे कोमल प्रेम दिखाते हैं।

ru.L: Благ {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} ко всем, и {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} милосердие — на всех {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} делах.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} добр ко всем; {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} сострадание объемлет всё, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сотворил.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} добр ко всем. Он с нежной любовью заботится обо всём, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сотворил.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はすべてのものに良い方。そのあわれみは、そのすべてのみわざの上にある。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はすべての人に良くしてくださる。その深いあわれみは、ご自分がお造りになったすべてのものに及ぶ。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、すべての人に良くしてくださる。ご自分がお造りになったすべてのものに、やさしい愛を示してくださる。

uk.L: Добрий {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} до всіх, і {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} милосердя — над усіма {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} ділами.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} добрий до кожного; {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} милосердя огортає все, що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} створив.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} добрий до всіх. Він виявляє ніжну любов до всього, що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} створив.

decisions.choice: his compassions: his tender love, shown again and again
decisions.reason: The plural (rachamim) is the usual form for compassion; it is the same root as "compassionate" in verse 8.

decisions.choice: over all his works: reaching all he has made
decisions.reason: His compassion rests on every creature, not only on Israel; verses 15-16 show it in the food he gives to all that lives.

decisions.choice: rachamaw "あわれみ" (L), "深いあわれみ" (B), "やさしい愛" (R)
decisions.reason: Psalter word for rachamim (PSA-3); his tender love shown again and again (m1).

source.text: יוֹד֣וּךָ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וַ֝חֲסִידֶ֗יךָ יְבָרֲכֽוּכָה׃

records.literal_gloss: They will thank you, YHWH, all your works, and your faithful [ones] will bless you.

en.L: All {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} works will give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful [ones] will bless {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, all {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} works will thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful people will bless {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, everything {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made will thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. Your faithful people will praise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Toutes {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} œuvres {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendront grâce, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} fidèles {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} béniront.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, toutes {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} œuvres {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercieront, et {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} fidèles {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} béniront.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, tout ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remerciera. Tes fidèles {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} loueront.

sw.L: Kazi {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} zote zitakushukuru, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q na waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} watakubariki.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kazi {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} zote zitakushukuru, \q na watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} waaminifu watakubariki.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kila kitu ulichokiumba kitakushukuru. \q Watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} waaminifu watakusifu.

es.L: Todas {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} obras {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} darán gracias, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} fieles {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} bendecirán.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, todas {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} obras {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} darán gracias, y {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} fieles {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} bendecirán.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, todo lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dará gracias. Tu pueblo fiel {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} alabará.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, mọi công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và những người trung tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ chúc tụng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, mọi loài {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dựng nên sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và những người trung tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ chúc tụng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, mọi vật {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dựng nên sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Những người trung tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 지으신 모든 것이 주님께 감사드리고, \q 주님의 신실한 이들이 주님을 송축할 것입니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 지으신 모든 것이 주님께 감사드리고, \q 주님의 신실한 백성이 주님을 송축할 것입니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 만드신 모든 것이 주님께 감사드릴 것입니다. \q 주님의 신실한 백성이 주님을 찬양할 것입니다.

pt.L: Todas as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} obras {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} renderão graças, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, e os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} fiéis {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} bendirão.
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, todas as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} obras {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} darão graças, e o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo fiel {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} bendirá.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, tudo o que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste vai {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} agradecer. O {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo fiel vai {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louvar.

am.L: ሥራዎችህ ሁሉ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ያመሰግኑሃል፤ \q ታማኞችህም ይባርኩሃል።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ሥራዎችህ ሁሉ ያመሰግኑሃል፤ \q ታማኝ ሕዝብህም ይባርኩሃል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ የፈጠርኸው ሁሉ ያመሰግንሃል። \q ታማኝ ሕዝብህ ያወድሱሃል።

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तेरे सब काम तेरा धन्यवाद करेंगे, और तेरे भक्त तुझे धन्य कहेंगे।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तेरे सब काम तेरा धन्यवाद करेंगे, और तेरे विश्वासयोग्य लोग तुझे धन्य कहेंगे।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, जो कुछ तूने बनाया है, वह सब तेरा धन्यवाद करेगा। तेरे विश्वासयोग्य लोग तेरी स्तुति करेंगे।

ru.L: Все {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} дела будут благодарить {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, и {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} верные будут благословлять {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, все {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} творения будут благодарить {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}, и {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} верные будут благословлять {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, всё, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} сотворил, будет благодарить {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}. Твои верные люди будут хвалить {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたのすべてのみわざは、あなたに感謝し、あなたの誠実な者たちは、あなたをほめたたえる。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたのすべてのみわざは、あなたに感謝し、あなたに誠実な人たちは、あなたをほめたたえる。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたがお造りになったものはみな、あなたに感謝する。あなたに忠実な人たちは、あなたをほめたたえる。

uk.L: Усі {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} діла дякуватимуть {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, і {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} вірні благословлятимуть {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, усі {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} діла дякуватимуть {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}}, і {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} вірні люди благословлятимуть {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, усе, що {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} створив, дякуватиме {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}}. Твої віддані люди хвалитимуть {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.

decisions.choice: all your works: all that God has made
decisions.reason: Creation itself gives thanks by what it is, as in 19:2 and 148; God's faithful people give thanks in words.

decisions.choice: the faithful: people of loyal love
decisions.reason: The word (chasidim) is related to chesed, loyal love: people who hold fast to the LORD in love and loyalty (4:4).

decisions.choice: "ታማኞችህ" (L), "ታማኝ ሕዝብህ" (B, R) for chasidim
decisions.reason: As 30:5 and 50:5 on main; the same root is "ታማኝ" when it is said of God in verse 17.

decisions.choice: भक्त (L); विश्वासयोग्य लोग (B, R)
decisions.reason: The chasidim are people of loyal love who hold fast to the LORD (m2); Literal uses the one word भक्त, Balanced and Readable say "faithful people", as the English does.

decisions.choice: chasidekha "あなたの誠実な者たち" (L), "あなたに誠実な人たち" (B), "あなたに忠実な人たち" (R)
decisions.reason: As 16:10 (PSA-2): chasid with 'your'. yevarakhukha ほめたたえる at R too (barekh).

source.text: כְּב֣וֹד מַלְכוּתְךָ֣ יֹאמֵ֑רוּ וּגְבוּרָתְךָ֥ יְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] glory of your kingdom they will speak, and your might they will tell,

en.L: The glory of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} kingdom they will tell, and [of] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} might they will speak,
en.B: They will speak of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} glorious reign and tell of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} power,
en.R: They will talk about how glorious {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} kingdom is. They will tell about {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} power.

fr.L: La gloire de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} règne, ils la diront, et [de] {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} puissance ils parleront,
fr.B: Ils parleront de la gloire de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} règne et raconteront {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} puissance,
fr.R: Ils diront combien {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} royaume est glorieux. Ils parleront de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} puissance.

sw.L: Utukufu wa ufalme {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} watausimulia, \q na [juu ya] uweza {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} watanena,
sw.B: Watazungumza juu ya utawala {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wenye utukufu \q na kusimulia uweza {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}},
sw.R: Watazungumza jinsi ufalme {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} ulivyo mtukufu. \q Watasimulia habari za uweza {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.

es.L: La gloria de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} reino dirán, y [de] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} poder hablarán,
es.B: Hablarán de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} glorioso reinado y contarán {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} poder,
es.R: Hablarán de lo glorioso que es {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} reino. Contarán {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} poder.

vi.L: Họ sẽ nói về vinh quang của vương quốc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và họ sẽ thuật lại quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.B: Họ sẽ nói về vương quyền vinh hiển của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q và thuật lại quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.R: Họ sẽ nói về vương quốc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vinh hiển biết bao. \q Họ sẽ kể về quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그들이 주님 나라의 영광을 말하고, \q 주님의 능력을 이야기할 것입니다,
ko.B: 그들은 주님의 영광스러운 통치를 말하고, \q 주님의 능력을 이야기할 것입니다.
ko.R: 그들은 주님의 나라가 얼마나 영광스러운지 이야기할 것입니다. \q 주님의 능력에 대해 말할 것입니다.

pt.L: A glória do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} reino dirão, e [do] {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} poder falarão,
pt.B: Eles falarão do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} reinado glorioso e contarão o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} poder,
pt.R: Eles vão falar de como o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} reino é glorioso. Vão contar sobre o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} poder.

am.L: የመንግሥትህን ክብር ይናገራሉ፤ \q ስለ ብርታትህም ያወራሉ፣
am.B: ስለ መንግሥትህ ክብር ይናገራሉ፤ \q ስለ ኃይልህም ያወራሉ፣
am.R: መንግሥትህ ምን ያህል የከበረች እንደ ሆነች ይናገራሉ። \q ስለ ኃይልህም ያወራሉ።

hi.L: वे तेरे राज्य की महिमा का वर्णन करेंगे, और तेरे पराक्रम [की] चर्चा करेंगे,
hi.B: वे तेरे महिमामय राज्य की चर्चा करेंगे और तेरे सामर्थ्य का बखान करेंगे,
hi.R: वे बताएँगे कि तेरा राज्य कितना महिमामय है। वे तेरे सामर्थ्य के बारे में बताएँगे।

ru.L: О славе {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} царства будут рассказывать и о {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} мощи будут говорить,
ru.B: Они будут говорить о славе {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} царствования и рассказывать о {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} силе,
ru.R: Они будут говорить о том, как славно {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} царство. Они будут рассказывать о {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} силе.

ja.L: 彼らは、あなたの王国の栄光を語り、あなたの力を告げる、
ja.B: 彼らは、あなたの王としての支配の栄光を語り、あなたの力を告げる。
ja.R: 彼らは、あなたの王国がどれほど栄光に満ちているかを話す。あなたの力について話す。

uk.L: Про славу {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} царства вони розповідатимуть, і [про] {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} могутність говоритимуть,
uk.B: Вони говоритимуть про {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} славне царювання і розповідатимуть про {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} силу,
uk.R: Вони говоритимуть про те, яке славне {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} царство. Вони розповідатимуть про {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} силу.

decisions.choice: your kingdom: your rule as King
decisions.reason: The word (malkhut) is the royal rule of God more than a territory. Verses 11-13 speak of the kingdom four times; the psalm opened with "my God, the King".

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: Verse 12 gives the purpose of this telling, so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: they: God's faithful people
decisions.reason: "They" are the faithful of verse 10.

decisions.choice: "vương quốc" (L, R), "vương quyền" (B) for God's kingdom
decisions.reason: The kingdom is God's rule as King (see the meaning decision). "vương quốc" says kingdom plainly; Balanced says "vương quyền" (royal rule), as the English Balanced says "reign".

decisions.choice: L ends with 、 and 145:12's purpose clause follows ("…知らせるために。"); B and R close the verse and restart 145:12 ("それは…ためである" B, "彼らは…願っている" R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew runs on into verse 12 (m2); L keeps the run with the purpose clause placed after, as Japanese poetry allows. malkhut "王国" (L, R), "王としての支配" (B, the English B's reign; m1).

source.text: לְהוֹדִ֤יעַ׀לִבְנֵ֣י הָ֭אָדָם גְּבוּרֹתָ֑יו וּ֝כְב֗וֹד הֲדַ֣ר מַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: to make known to [the] sons of humankind his mighty deeds and [the] glory of [the] splendor of his kingdom.

en.L: to make known to the sons of humankind {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mighty deeds and the glory of the splendor of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} kingdom.
en.B: to make {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mighty acts known to all people, and the glorious splendor of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} reign.
en.R: They want all people to know about the powerful things God has done and how glorious and wonderful {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} kingdom is.

fr.L: pour faire connaître aux fils des humains {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} hauts faits et la gloire de la splendeur de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} règne.
fr.B: pour faire connaître à tous les humains {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} actes puissants et la splendeur glorieuse de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} règne.
fr.R: Ils veulent que tout le monde sache les choses puissantes que Dieu a faites, et combien {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} royaume est glorieux et merveilleux.

sw.L: ili kuwajulisha wanadamu matendo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} makuu \q na utukufu wa fahari ya ufalme {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: ili kuyajulisha matendo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} makuu kwa watu wote, \q na fahari tukufu ya utawala {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: Wanataka watu wote wajue mambo makuu ambayo Mungu ametenda \q na jinsi ufalme {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} ulivyo mtukufu na wa ajabu.

es.L: para dar a conocer a los hijos de la humanidad {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} hechos poderosos y la gloria del esplendor de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} reino.
es.B: para dar a conocer a toda la gente {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} hechos poderosos y el glorioso esplendor de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} reinado.
es.R: Quieren que toda la gente sepa de las cosas poderosas que Dios ha hecho y de lo glorioso y maravilloso que es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} reino.

vi.L: để cho con cái loài người biết những việc quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q và vinh quang của sự huy hoàng của vương quốc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: để mọi người được biết những việc quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và vẻ huy hoàng vinh hiển của vương quyền {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Họ muốn mọi người biết những việc quyền năng Đức Chúa Trời đã làm, \q và vương quốc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vinh hiển, tuyệt diệu biết bao.

ko.L: 사람의 자녀들에게 그분의 능하신 일들과 그분 나라의 위엄의 영광을 알리려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 그것은 모든 사람에게 그분의 능하신 일들과 그분의 통치의 영광스러운 위엄을 알리려는 것입니다.
ko.R: 그들은 모든 사람이 하나님께서 하신 능력 있는 일들과 그분의 나라가 얼마나 영광스럽고 \q 놀라운지 알기를 바랍니다.

pt.L: para fazer conhecer aos filhos da humanidade os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} feitos poderosos e a glória do esplendor do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} reino.
pt.B: para dar a conhecer a todas as pessoas os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} atos poderosos e o glorioso esplendor do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} reinado.
pt.R: Eles querem que todas as pessoas saibam das coisas poderosas que Deus fez e de como o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} reino é glorioso e maravilhoso.

am.L: ለሰው ልጆች ብርቱ ሥራዎቹን፣ \q የመንግሥቱንም የግርማ ክብር ያስታውቁ ዘንድ።
am.B: ብርቱ ሥራዎቹንና የመንግሥቱን የከበረ ግርማ \q ለሰዎች ሁሉ ያስታውቁ ዘንድ።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ያደረጋቸውን ኃያል ነገሮችና መንግሥቱ ምን ያህል የከበረችና ድንቅ እንደ ሆነች ሰዎች ሁሉ እንዲያውቁ ይፈልጋሉ።

hi.L: कि मनुष्य की सन्तान पर उनके पराक्रम के काम और उनके राज्य के वैभव की महिमा प्रकट करें।
hi.B: ताकि सब लोग उनके पराक्रम के कामों को और उनके राज्य के महिमामय वैभव को जान लें।
hi.R: वे चाहते हैं कि सब लोग उन सामर्थी कामों के बारे में जानें जो परमेश्वर ने किए हैं, और जानें कि उनका राज्य कितना महिमामय और अद्भुत है।

ru.L: чтобы возвестить сынам человеческим {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} могучие деяния и славу великолепия {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} царства.
ru.B: чтобы {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} могучие дела стали известны всем людям, и славное великолепие {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} царствования.
ru.R: Они хотят, чтобы все люди узнали о великих делах, которые совершил Бог, и о том, как славно и прекрасно {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} царство.

ja.L: 人の子らに、その方の力あるわざと、その王国の輝きの栄光とを知らせるために。
ja.B: それは、その方の力あるわざと、その支配の栄光に満ちた輝きとを、すべての人に知らせるためである。
ja.R: 彼らは、神がなさった力強いことと、神の王国がどれほど栄光に満ちてすばらしいかを、すべての人に知ってほしいと願っている。

uk.L: щоб дати пізнати синам людським {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} могутні вчинки і славу пишноти {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} царства.
uk.B: щоб усі люди пізнали {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} могутні діла і славну пишноту {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} царювання.
uk.R: Вони хочуть, щоб усі люди знали про могутні речі, які зробив Бог, і про те, яке славне й чудове {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} царство.

decisions.choice: his: God's
decisions.reason: The psalm turns from speaking to God ("your kingdom") to speaking about him ("his kingdom"), because these words are what is told to other people.

decisions.choice: the sons of humankind: human beings
decisions.reason: "Sons of adam" is an ordinary way of saying people, men and women (11:4).

decisions.choice: They want ... God
decisions.reason: Readable starts a new sentence, so it names who wants this, the faithful of verse 10, and names God, whom the Hebrew calls "his".

decisions.choice: "règne" (Literal, Balanced) and "royaume" (Readable) for malkhut
decisions.reason: Malkhut is God's rule as King, as the meaning decision says; "règne" says the rule, "royaume" is the plainer word for young readers, as the English Readable says "kingdom".

decisions.choice: उनके (honorific third person)
decisions.reason: The psalm turns from "your kingdom" to "his kingdom" (m1); Hindi follows with the honorific third person for God. "Sons of humankind" means people, men and women, so Literal says मनुष्य की सन्तान, the default form of the Psalms' gender span, without a span, as the English has none.

decisions.choice: livnei ha'adam "人の子ら" (L), "すべての人" (B, R); gevurotaw "その方の力あるわざ" (L, B), "神がなさった" (R)
decisions.reason: Psalter rule for bene adam (PSA-1); the Hebrew changes to 'his' (m1), so L and B use その方, R names God as the English R does (r-en-1).

source.text: מַֽלְכוּתְךָ֗ מַלְכ֥וּת כָּל־עֹֽלָמִ֑ים וּ֝מֶֽמְשֶׁלְתְּךָ֗ בְּכָל־דּ֥וֹר וָדֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: Your kingdom [is] a kingdom of all ages, and your dominion [is] in every generation and generation.

en.L: Your kingdom [is] a kingdom of all ages, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} dominion [is] in every generation and generation.
en.B: Your kingdom is a kingdom for all the ages, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} rule lasts through every generation.
en.R: Your kingdom will never end. You will rule over people in every age that will ever come.

fr.L: Ton règne [est] un règne de tous les siècles, et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} domination [est] dans toute génération et génération.
fr.B: Ton règne est un règne pour tous les siècles, et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} domination dure de génération en génération.
fr.R: Ton royaume ne finira jamais. Tu régneras sur les gens de toutes les époques qui viendront.

sw.L: Ufalme {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} [ni] ufalme wa zama zote, \q na utawala {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} [uko] katika kila kizazi na kizazi.
sw.B: Ufalme {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} ni ufalme wa zama zote, \q na utawala {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} unadumu katika kila kizazi.
sw.R: Ufalme {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} hautakwisha kamwe. \q Utawatawala watu katika kila kizazi kitakachokuja.

es.L: Tu reino [es] reino de todos los siglos, y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} dominio [es] por todas las generaciones.
es.B: Tu reino es un reino para todos los siglos, y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} dominio dura por todas las generaciones.
es.R: Tu reino nunca se acabará. Reinarás sobre la gente de todas las épocas que vendrán.

vi.L: Vương quốc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] vương quốc của mọi thời đại, \q và quyền cai trị của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [còn] từ đời nọ sang đời kia.
vi.B: Vương quốc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là vương quốc muôn đời, \q và quyền cai trị của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn mãi qua mọi thế hệ.
vi.R: Vương quốc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không bao giờ chấm dứt. \q Ngài sẽ cai trị loài người trong mọi thời đại sẽ đến.

ko.L: 주님의 나라는 모든 영원의 나라이고, \q 주님의 통치는 모든 세대와 세대에 [이릅니다].
ko.B: 주님의 나라는 영원한 나라이고, \q 주님의 통치는 모든 세대에 걸쳐 이어집니다.
ko.R: 주님의 나라는 결코 끝나지 않을 것입니다. \q 주님께서는 앞으로 올 모든 시대의 사람들을 다스리실 것입니다.

pt.L: O {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} reino [é] um reino de todos os séculos, e o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} domínio [está] em toda geração e geração.
pt.B: O {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} reino é um reino para todos os séculos, e o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} domínio dura por todas as gerações.
pt.R: O {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} reino nunca vai acabar. Tu vais reinar sobre as pessoas em todas as épocas que ainda virão.

am.L: መንግሥትህ የዘመናት ሁሉ መንግሥት [ናት]፤ \q ግዛትህም በትውልድና በትውልድ ሁሉ [ነው]።
am.B: መንግሥትህ ለዘመናት ሁሉ የምትኖር መንግሥት ናት፤ \q ግዛትህም ከትውልድ እስከ ትውልድ ይኖራል።
am.R: መንግሥትህ ፍጻሜ የላትም። \q ወደፊት በሚመጣው ዘመን ሁሉ ሰዎችን ትገዛለህ።

hi.L: तेरा राज्य सब युगों का राज्य [है], और तेरी प्रभुता पीढ़ी से पीढ़ी तक [बनी रहती है]।
hi.B: तेरा राज्य सब युगों तक रहनेवाला राज्य है, और तेरा शासन हर पीढ़ी में बना रहता है।
hi.R: तेरा राज्य कभी समाप्त नहीं होगा। आनेवाले हर युग में तू लोगों पर राज्य करेगा।

ru.L: Твоё царство — царство всех веков, и {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} власть — во всяком роде и роде.
ru.B: Твоё царство — царство на все века, и {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} власть длится во всех поколениях.
ru.R: Твоё царство никогда не кончится. Ты будешь править людьми во все времена, какие только наступят.

ja.L: あなたの王国は、とこしえにわたる王国、あなたの支配は、代々に及ぶ。
ja.B: あなたの王国は、永遠に続く王国。あなたの支配は、すべての世代に続く。
ja.R: あなたの王国は、決して終わらない。あなたの支配は、これから来るどの時代にも続く。

uk.L: Твоє царство — царство всіх віків, і {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} панування — в кожному роді й роді.
uk.B: Твоє царство — царство на всі віки, і {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} панування триває через кожне покоління.
uk.R: Твоєму царству ніколи не буде кінця. Ти пануватимеш над людьми в кожну епоху, яка тільки настане.

decisions.choice: the missing nun line: the Hebrew text has none
alternatives: God is faithful in his words and kind in all his works (the ancient Greek translation and a Dead Sea scroll)
decisions.reason: After this verse, the line beginning with the letter nun is missing from the Hebrew text, and the Hebrew alphabet goes on with samekh in verse 14. The ancient Greek translation and the Psalms scroll from cave 11 at Qumran have a line here beginning with nun: "Faithful is God in his words, and kind (or holy) in all his works". Its second half is the same as verse 17. It may be an original line that was lost, or one written later to fill the gap. The renderings follow the Hebrew text.
